第6版は遠方PEC外端、PMLなし、半体積平均の整合界面と真空モニター。旧周期/PEC・PML例を保持。 単位系: 無次元。長さ・時間・場を規格化。 Yee FDTDの専用配布版と固定入力 教育用Yee FDTD。真空・Fresnel界面・s/p偏光・PMLの既存例を保持し、第6版で一次元垂直入射のOhmic・受動Lorentz板を追加。帯域解析解、反射・透過・直接散逸・物質蓄積、修正離散収支・物理流束と格子・時間収束を分けて検査。一般分散、多共鳴、斜め分散入射、分散PML、一般2/3次元の包括的検証ではない。 追加固定例：Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。 追加固定例：任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。 追加固定例：有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。 取得・実行手順 / README · コード・固定入力・結果 ZIP · Other names: FDTD法 / finite difference time domain / 有限差分時間領域法 / Yee法 Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example New r6: linear isotropic passive nonmagnetic finite slabs in vacuum, 1D normal incidence, one Lorentz resonance or Ohmic conduction. Earlier TMz/TEz cases retained. Boundaries: New r6: distant PEC caps, no PML, aligned half-volume slab interfaces and vacuum monitors. Earlier periodic/PEC and PML examples retained. Units: Dimensionless normalized length, time and fields. Dedicated Yee FDTD edition and fixed inputs Educational Yee FDTD: retained vacuum/Fresnel/s-p/PML examples plus r6 1D normal-incidence Ohmic and passive Lorentz slabs. Spectral references, R/T, direct dissipation, material storage, modified/physical budgets and space/time refinement are separate checks. Not blanket validation of general dispersion, multiple resonances, oblique dispersive incidence, dispersive PML or general 2D/3D. Additional fixed examples: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials. Additional fixed examples: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed. Additional fixed examples: The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, fixed inputs and results ZIP · File manifest /
